texts.zh:
有报道称[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在酝酿着一个鹰派运动，而一位老兵象征性地处于这个运动的核心地位。他们通过对我们过去可以任意进犯、踏平其他帝国的浪漫主义化，来敦促我们提出更激进的议程，为我们自己的人民带来更多的利益，同时削弱我们的对手。

在当前脆弱而短暂的和平下，他们很快获得了广大穷人和军人的支持。如果觉得这个运动会带来麻烦的话，我们的顾问指出，这个运动的关键角色就是那位有名无实的领袖，如果移除这个惹麻烦的元素，整个运动就会土崩瓦解。
texts.en:
There are reports of a hawkish movement brewing on [Root.Capital.GetName], with a decorated veteran at its center. Romanticizing a past where we were free to attack and raze other empires, they demand a more warlike agenda to supposedly bring out the best in our own people while weakening our rivals.

With our current peace - tenuous as it might be - they have quickly found themselves a large following among the poor and within the military. If we consider this to be an issue, our advisors indicate that the movement hinges on its figurehead veteran - remove this problematic element, and the whole movement would fall apart.

label.zh: 其实他们的议程还恰好挺符合我们的计划的。
label.en: Actually, their little agenda lines up with our own plans.

label.zh: 在事态失控前结束这场闹剧吧。
label.en: Put an end to it before it gets out of hand.

texts.zh:
由于之前的运动被默许，上个月他们要求政府摆出更加好战姿态的呼声不断提高。当我们的领导层和运动之间的冲突达到顶点时，我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]公开表示支持该运动。

很明显，我们不仅支持它，而且准备应允递交过来的许多要求，一大群追随者正急切地等待着我们的下一步行动。
texts.en:
As they were allowed to continue unabated, the movement demanding a more warlike agenda from our government has only increased in strength the last month. When the conflict between our leadership and the movement came to a head, our [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] publicly embraced the movement.

As it has become clear that we not only support it, but are ready to follow the many demands handed over to us, the large group of followers are eagerly awaiting what we will do next.

label.zh: 我们会给他们的原领袖找个职位。
label.en: We will find a position for their old leader.

label.zh: 是时候接受我们帝国内部的军事倾向了。
label.en: It is time to embrace our empire's military tendencies.

label.zh: 我们将利用手头的资源来恢复往昔的荣耀舰队。
label.en: Our resources will be spent on restoring our ships to their former glory.

texts.zh:
我们收到附属国[subject_empire.GetName]的报告。该报告概述了民众是如何被他们的一名退伍军人煽动得头脑发狂。他们目前正在寻找一个发泄怒火的渠道，他们要求他们的领袖发动战争。

为了火速平息骚乱，[subject_empire.GetName]的政府已经接受了这个运动，并做出了一些承诺，但我们的线人十分怀疑他们能否兑现。
texts.en:
We have received a report from a vassal empire of ours, the [subject_empire.GetName]. The reports outlines how the people have been whipped into a frenzy by one of their veteran soldiers, and they are now looking for an outlet for their anger. They are demanding war from their leaders.

In a desperate move to appease the rioters, the government in [subject_empire.GetName] has embraced the movement and made several promises that our informant doubt they can fulfil.

label.zh: 所以他们想让我们更好战，对吗?
label.en: So they want us to be more warlike, do they?
